Ngempela samuthumela uNuhu esizweni sakhe, ukuba: “Xwayisa abantu bakho bengakatholi isijeziso esibuhlungu”.
Wathi: “bantu bami, ngingumxwayisi ocacile kini”.
Khonzani u Allah nimuthobele futhi ningilalele.
Uzonithethelela izimpambuko zenu futhi uyonigcina kuze kube isikhathi esinqunyiwe. Bheka ngoba isikhathi esinqunywe u Allah asisoze sahlehliswa, ukube nje benazi.
Wathi: “Nkosi yami, ngimeme isizwe sami ubusuku nemini; ”
Kepha ukubamema kwami kubenze babaleka ngokudlangile.
Kuthi njalo uma ngibamema ukuze ubathethelele, bavame bafake iminwe ezindlebeni zabo bazimboze ngezambatho zabo futhi baphikelele bezigqaja.
Ngibamema esidlangalaleni.
Ngabamemeza ngaphinde ngakhuluma nabo ngasese.
Ngathi: “celani intethelelo eNkosini yenu ngokuba Yona iyahethelela.
Izonehlisela imvula ngenala.
Inandisele ingcebo nenzalo futhi anenzele izivande nemifula.
Yini ngani ningakhombisi inhlonipho ku Allah na?
Ebe anidala izigaba ngezigaba.
Anibonanga ukuthi u Allah uwadale kanjani amazulu ayisikhombisa alakelana.
Wenza inyanga yaba ukukhanya kuwo, wenza ilanga isibani.
U Allah unidale ngomhlabathi.
Futhi uyonibuyisela kuwo aphinde anikhiphe kuwo.
U Allah unenzele umhlaba wendlaleka;
Ukuze nenze imizila ngemizila”.
UNuhu wathi: “Nkosi yami, ngempela abangilalelanga, balandela lowo odukiswe kakhulu ingcebo yakhe nezingane zakhe;”
Futhi bakha uzungu olukhulu.
Bathi: “Ningazishiyi izikhonzwa zenu, ningabashiyi oWadu noSuwa’u noYaguta noYa’uka kanye noNasru.”
Empeleni baningi ababadukisile, yenzake labo abaphambukile bagxile ekudukeni.
Ngenxa yezimpambuko zabo, baminziswa bafakwa eMlilweni; abazange bathole abasizi ngaphandle kwa Allah.
UNuhu wabe esethi: “Nkosi yami, ungashiyi muntu ophilayo kulabo abangakholwa”.
“Ngokuba uma ubayeka bazodukisa izinceku zakho futhi bazolokho bezala eminye imigulukudu engakholwa”.
“Nkosi yami ngithethelele mina kanye nabazali bami nalowo ongena emzini wami ekholwa, nalabo abesilisa nabesifazane abakholwayo futhi wandisele labo abaphambukile ekulahlekelweni”.
